final_record_set.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over pretty JSON plus final newline for the work_item_id-sorted array of {work_item_id,status,sha256(file_bytes)} rows

future_maintenance_rule: The live migration entry point permanently refuses replay independent of this finalization artifact's presence. The archived replay-capable bytes are audit evidence only and are never a live writer. Future planning edits update the owning work-item record through reviewed maintenance; future status changes append a reviewed status_transaction_chain and satisfy the current checker, evidence, and literal contract. Neither path reruns reconciliation templates.
owns: dated proof of the one-time migration output and unchanged-status transaction
nonclaim: The migration and this digest implement no runtime behavior, close no work item or stage, and create no successful exit evidence.
